name: A structural commit is observed only as one atomic safepoint publication

input.fixture_ref: Continuously observe two Classes from participating runtime threads while one transaction group changes both and publishes state and invalidation metadata.

applicability.reason: Requires participating runtime threads plus safepoint instrumentation, and the first half is structurally blocked. C041 asks observers on OTHER threads to see either both old revisions or both new ones while a transaction group publishes, so it needs a second thread executing Iris code against the same registry. Runtime values are `Rc<RefCell<..>>` and therefore not `Send`, so no Iris value or registry can cross a thread boundary today. The atomicity itself is already enforced in-thread: `publish_group` validates and publishes a whole group under one commit, and META-V932 and the rollback rows observe that no partial mix is published. What is unobservable is the CONCURRENT half.

expect.status: Observers see either both old revisions or both new revisions, never a partial structural mix, and execution resumes after atomic publication.
